problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. The packages are as follows:
* Package 1: size 36 units
* Package 2: size 39 units
* Package 3: size 56 units
* Package 4: size 43 units
* Package 5: size 58 units
* Package 6: size 69 units
* Package 7: size 34 units
* Package 8: size 57 units
* Package 9: size 65 units
* Package 10: size 55 units
* Package 11: size 32 units
* Package 12: size 41 units
* Package 13: size 45 units
* Package 14: size 61 units
* Package 15: size 44 units
* Package 16: size 38 units
* Package 17: size 47 units

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 units. Assign all packages using the fewest trucks possible. Each package must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total size of packages in any truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
